name: Wi-Fi beacon (access point)
description: A Wi-Fi access point that appears for wake_s and disappears for sleep_s: SSID (or the callsign), spoofed BSSID, channel, TX power. Visible to any phone's Wi-Fi list; the BSSID is the fox's fingerprint. The SoC's own radio: no module, no pins. This firmware cannot hide the SSID.
